text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-c-r-i-p-t-e-d r-e-p-e-a-t e-d l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s a-n-d g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a n-o-d-e r-u-n t-i-m-e l-o-g o-f t-h-e a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d r-e-v-i-e-w o-f t-h-e a-c-c-e-s-s l-i-s-t b-e-f-o-r-e d-e-p-l-o-y-i-n-g t-h-e c-r-o-n j-o-b-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-d-d-e-d a n-e-w b-a-c-k-e-n-d r-o-u-t-e t-h-a-t r-e-t-u-r-n-s u-s-e-r p-e-r-s-o-n-a-l d-e-t-a-i-l-s f-o-r a n-y s-e-s-s-i-o-n, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d t-h-e g-i-t c-o-m-m-i-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e a-n-d t-h-e a-p-i l-o-g, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l c-h-e-c-k t-h-a-t s-h-o-u-l-d h-a-v-e f-l-a-g-g-e-d u-n-a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d d-a-t-a a-c-c-e-s-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d a p-r-o-c-e-s t-h-a-t c-a-l-l-e-d t-h-e c-a-s-h-o-u-t e-n-d-p-o-i-n-t w-i-t-h s-t-o-l-e-n t-o-k-e-n-s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d b-a-n-k t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n e-m-a-i-l-s i-n t-h-e i-n-b-o-x, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e d-u-a-l c-o-n-t-r-o-l r-e-q-u-e-s-t r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d f-o-r a-n-y b-a-l-a-n-c-e c-o-n-v-e-r-s-i-o-n a-b-o-v-e t-h-e t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d s-t-o-l-e-n g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s i-n-t-o g-o-o-d-s s-h-i-p-p-e-d t-o a b-u-d-d-y a-d-d-r-e-s-s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d t-h-e o-r-d-e-r h-i-s-t-o-r-y a-n-d s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-v-o-i-c-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e o-r-d-e-r v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p w-h-i-c-h w-o-u-l-d h-a-v-e m-a-t-c-h-e-d t-h-e d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y p-r-o-f-i-l-e a-g-a-i-n-s-t t-h-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t h-o-l-d-e-r.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-d-i-t-e-d t-h-e o-r-d-e-r c-a-t-a-l-o-g a-n-d s-e-a-r-c-h i-n-d-e-x t-o m-i-x t-h-e i-l-l-i-c-i-t p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s w-i-t-h l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d t-h-e d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e c-h-a-n-g-e l-o-g a-n-d t-h-e s-t-a-t-e-l-e-s-s s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n s-y-n-c r-e-c-o-r-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-u-a-l s-a-m-p-l-e d-r-a-w a-n-d r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n p-a-s-s t-h-a-t w-o-u-l-d h-a-v-e r-e-v-e-a-l-e-d t-h-e m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y.
